CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueById] ( @Id bigint ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select string_agg(results.[value],'') as DisplayValue from (select top 100 coalesce(D.FormattedValue, D.value) as [value] from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID outer apply ( select TL.value, coalesce(case when TL.Value = 'FirstName' then R.FirstName + ' ' else R.LastName end, F.FormattedValue, RI.Code, G.Name) as FormattedValue, TF.[index] as [TokenIndex] from [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(T.DisplayFormat, '{', '|'), '|') TF cross apply [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(TF.[value], '}', '|'), '|') TL left join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = T.ID and FT.Name like TL.Value left join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.ObjectType = A.Object AND F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID left join Asset RI on TL.Value = 'Code' and A.Object = 'ReferenceItem' and RI.ID = A.ID left join [Group] G on TL.Value = 'Name' and A.Object = 'Group' and G.ID = A.ObjectID left join reporting.Global_resource R on TL.Value in ('FirstName', 'LastName') and A.Object = 'Resource' and R.ResourceID = A.ObjectID where RTRIM(TF.value) <> '' and RTRIM(TL.value) <> '' ) D where A.ID = @Id order by D.TokenIndex) results
)
